welcome: Party waypoint sharing and quest-follow updates are working together again, with a clearer follower indicator.

sections.title: Waypoints and quest focus
items: Fixed normal WoW map pins not reaching your party as class-colored waypoint markers when waypoint sharing is enabled.
Having a map pin no longer interrupts quest-focus and follow-status updates. Choosing another quest while following once again asks whether to stop following; Cancel keeps the follow active.

sections.title: A clearer follower indicator
items: On the objective tracker, party members following your quest focus now appear as a class-colored chain link in place of the hollow ring. The extra icon beside the ring is gone.
